title.zh: 卷四十 本紀第四十 寧宗四
title.raw: 卷四十 本紀第四十 寧宗四 Volume 40 Annals 40: Ningzong 4

sentences.zh: 十年春正月癸巳，雨土。

translations.literal: In spring of the tenth year, first month, on the day guisi, dust fell like rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the tenth year of Jiading (1217), on the day guisi, dust rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大風。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, great winds blew.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei, fierce winds arose.

sentences.zh: 庚子，遣錢撫賀金主生辰。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Qian Fu was dispatched to congratulate the Jin ruler on his birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi, Qian Fu was sent as envoy to offer birthday congratulations to the Jin emperor.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，地震。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day gengshen, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day gengshen, the earth quaked.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未朔，金人犯光州中渡鎮，執榷場官盛允升殺之，遂分兵犯樊城。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, first day dingwei, Jin forces attacked Zhongdu Town in Guang Prefecture, seized and killed the monopoly-market official Sheng Yunsheng, then divided their forces to attack Fancheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the first day dingwei, Jin troops struck Zhongdu Town in Guang Prefecture, seized the border-market officer Sheng Yunsheng and killed him, then split their forces to advance on Fancheng.

sentences.zh: 戊申，鄂州、江陵府副都統王守中引兵拒之，金人遂分兵圍棗陽、光化軍。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Vice Commander-in-Chief Wang Shouzhong of Ezhou and Jiangling Prefecture led troops to resist; the Jin then divided forces to besiege Zaoyang and Guanghua Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen, Vice Commander-in-Chief Wang Shouzhong of Ezhou and Jiangling led troops to meet them; the Jin thereupon detached columns to besiege Zaoyang and Guanghua Army.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔江淮制置使李玨、京湖制置使趙方措置調遣，仍聽便宜行事。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, an edict ordered Li Jue, Commissioner of the Huai and Yang regions, and Zhao Fang, Commissioner of Jing and Hu, to arrange deployments and transfers, granting them discretion to act as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen, the throne ordered Li Jue, Commissioner of the Huai and Yang circuits, and Zhao Fang, Commissioner of Jing and Hu, to organize troop movements and deployments, with authority to act at their discretion as the situation demanded.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命四川制置使董居誼酌量緩急，便宜行事。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Dong Juyi, Commissioner of Sichuan, was ordered to weigh urgency and act at his discretion.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi, Dong Juyi, Commissioner of Sichuan, was instructed to judge what was urgent and to act on his own authority as needed.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，廬州鈐轄王辛敗金人於光山縣之安昌砦，殺其統軍完顏掩。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Supervisory Controller Wang Xin of Luzhou defeated Jin forces at Anchang Stockade in Guangshan County and killed their commander Wanyan Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou, Supervisory Controller Wang Xin of Luzhou routed the Jin at Anchang Stockade in Guangshan County and killed their commander Wanyan Yan.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，金兵遁去，隨州、光化皆以捷聞。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the Jin army withdrew; Suizhou and Guanghua both reported victories.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu, the Jin army withdrew; Suizhou and Guanghua both reported victories.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔出戍官兵金給其家。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, an edict provided gold to the families of officers and soldiers on frontier deployment.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao, an edict ordered that gold be paid to the families of officers and soldiers serving on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，以久雨，釋大理、三衙、臨安府杖以下囚，蠲茶鹽賞錢。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day xinsi, owing to prolonged rain, prisoners below the cane punishment threshold in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Yamen, and Lin'an Prefecture were released, and tea-salt reward monies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day xinsi, because of prolonged rain, prisoners subject to beating or lesser punishments in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Yamen, and Lin'an Prefecture were released, and tea-and-salt reward payments were waived.

sentences.zh: 甲申，賜禮部進士吳潛以下五百二十有三人及第、出身。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, three hundred and twenty-three Jinshi graduates including Wu Qian of the Ministry of Rites were granted metropolitan degrees and appointment qualifications.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen, three hundred and twenty-three graduates of the metropolitan examination, including Wu Qian of the Ministry of Rites, were granted jinshi degrees and official appointment.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，趙方請下詔伐金，遂傳檄招諭中原官吏軍民。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Zhao Fang requested an edict to attack the Jin; a proclamation was then circulated to summon officials, soldiers, and civilians of the Central Plains.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao, Zhao Fang asked that an edict be issued to campaign against the Jin; a proclamation was then distributed calling on officials, soldiers, and civilians of the Central Plains to rise.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day gengxu, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day gengxu, Venus appeared in the daytime sky.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔厲將士，募京西忠義人進討。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, an edict exhorted generals and soldiers and recruited loyal volunteers of Jingxi for advance campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu, an edict roused generals and troops and called for loyal volunteers from Jingxi to join the advance against the enemy.

sentences.zh: 辛未，東川大水。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, eastern Sichuan suffered severe flooding.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei, eastern Sichuan was struck by catastrophic floods.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，太白經天。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Venus crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou, Venus traversed the sky.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, first day bingzi, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the first day bingzi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以旱，釋諸路杖以下囚。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, owing to drought, prisoners below the cane punishment threshold in all circuits were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin, because of drought, prisoners subject to beating or lesser punishments in all circuits were released.

sentences.zh: 甲申，雅州蠻寇邊，焚碉門砦，遣兵討之。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Yi tribesmen raided the border, burned Diaomen Stockade, and troops were dispatched to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen, tribal forces from Yazhou raided the frontier, burned Diaomen Stockade, and troops were sent to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，嗣濮王不儔薨。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Heir to the Prince of Pu, Bu Chou, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai, Bu Chou, heir to the Prince of Pu, died.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔諸軍將佐有罪者送屯駐州鞫之，罷軍士淫刑。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, an edict ordered that guilty officers and assistants in all armies be sent to the garrison prefectures for investigation, and abusive punishments of soldiers were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi, an edict directed that guilty officers and aides in all armies be sent to the prefectures where their units were stationed for trial, and the abusive punishment of soldiers was abolished.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，詔監司、郡守各舉威勇才略可將帥者二人。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yichou, an edict ordered surveillance commissioners and prefects each to nominate two persons of martial valor and strategic talent fit for command.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day yichou, an edict required each surveillance commissioner and prefect to recommend two men of martial courage and strategic ability fit to serve as generals.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙巳朔，以久雨，釋大理、三衙、臨安府及兩浙諸州杖以下囚。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, first day yisi, owing to prolonged rain, prisoners below the cane punishment threshold in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Yamen, Lin'an Prefecture, and the prefectures of the two Zhe circuits were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the first day yisi, because of prolonged rain, prisoners subject to beating or lesser punishments in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Yamen, Lin'an Prefecture, and the prefectures of the two Zhe circuits were released.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，蠲三衙、江上諸軍公私逋負錢。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, arrears in public and private debts owed by the Three Yamen and armies along the Yangtze were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou, public and private debts owed by the Three Yamen and the armies along the Yangtze were remitted.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁丑，大風。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day dingchou, great winds blew.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day dingchou, fierce winds arose.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen, Venus appeared in the daytime sky.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔浙東提舉司發米十萬石振給貧民。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, an edict ordered the Zhedong Intendant's Office to issue one hundred thousand shi of rice to relieve the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen, an edict ordered the Zhedong Intendant's Office to distribute one hundred thousand shi of rice to relieve the poor.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太白經天。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Venus crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu, Venus traversed the sky.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，以軍興，募民納粟補官。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day wushen, owing to the war effort, commoners were recruited to offer grain in exchange for official appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day wushen, because of the war mobilization, commoners were invited to offer grain in exchange for official rank.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔武舉人毋復應文舉。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, an edict forbade military examination graduates from again taking the civil examinations.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao, an edict forbade graduates of the military examination from sitting for the civil examinations again.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，金鳳翔副統軍完顏贇以步騎萬人犯四川。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Wanyan Yun, Jin Vice Commander of Fengxiang, invaded Sichuan with ten thousand infantry and cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai, Wanyan Yun, Jin vice commander at Fengxiang, invaded Sichuan with ten thousand foot and horse soldiers.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，迫湫池堡。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, they pressed Qiu Pond Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen, they pressed Qiu Pond Stockade.

sentences.zh: 己巳，破天水軍，守臣黃炎孫遁。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, they overran Tianshui Army; the defending official Huang Yansun fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi, they overran Tianshui Army; the defending official Huang Yansun fled.

sentences.zh: 金人攻白環堡，破之。

translations.literal: Jin forces attacked Baihuan Stockade and took it.
translations.idiomatic: Jin forces attacked Baihuan Stockade and captured it.

sentences.zh: 庚午，迫黃牛堡，統制劉雄棄大散關遁，金人據之。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, they pressed Huangniu Stockade; Controller Liu Xiong abandoned Dasanguan and fled; the Jin seized it.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu, they pressed Huangniu Stockade; Controller Liu Xiong abandoned Dasanguan and fled, and the Jin occupied the pass.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月壬午，京東路忠義李全率衆來歸，詔以全爲京東路總管。

translations.literal: In spring of the eleventh year, first month, on the day renwu, Li Quan of the Jingdong loyal volunteers led his followers in submission; an edict appointed Quan Jingdong Circuit commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the eleventh year (1218), on the day renwu, Li Quan of the Jingdong loyal volunteers led his followers in submission; an edict appointed Quan overall commander of Jingdong Circuit.

sentences.zh: 戊子，金人圍皂郊堡。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Jin forces besieged Zaojiao Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi, Jin forces besieged Zaojiao Stockade.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，利州將麻仲率忠義人焚秦州永寧砦。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, General Ma Zhong of Lizhou led loyal volunteers to burn Yongning Stockade in Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen, General Ma Zhong of Lizhou led loyal volunteers to burn Yongning Stockade in Qin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以度僧牒千給四川軍費。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, one thousand Buddhist ordination certificates were issued to fund Sichuan military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei, one thousand ordination certificates were issued to help pay Sichuan's military costs.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔四川忠義人立功，賞視官軍。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, an edict declared that meritorious service by Sichuan loyal volunteers would be rewarded on the same scale as regular troops.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou, an edict declared that loyal volunteers in Sichuan who achieved merit would be rewarded on the same terms as regular troops.

sentences.zh: 金人犯隔芽關，興元都統李貴遁，官軍大潰。

translations.literal: Jin forces attacked Geya Pass; Commander-in-Chief Li Gui of Xingyuan fled and the regular army collapsed in rout.
translations.idiomatic: Jin forces attacked Geya Pass; Commander-in-Chief Li Gui of Xingyuan fled, and the regular army broke in complete rout.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰，金人焚大散關而去。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jiachen, the Jin burned Dasanguan and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day jiachen, the Jin burned Dasanguan and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，沔州都統王大才馬蹶，死於河池。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Wang Dacai, Commander-in-Chief of Minzhou, was thrown from his horse and died at Hechi.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi, Wang Dacai, Commander-in-Chief of Min Prefecture, was thrown from his horse and died at Hechi.

sentences.zh: 丙午，金人破皂郊，死者五萬人。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, the Jin broke Zaojiao; fifty thousand died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu, the Jin overran Zaojiao; fifty thousand were killed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，金人破湫池堡。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, the Jin took Qiu Pond Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei, the Jin captured Qiu Pond Stockade.

sentences.zh: 戊申，金人圍隨州、棗陽軍，遊騎至漢上，均州守臣應謙之棄城走。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the Jin besieged Suizhou and Zaoyang Army; raiding cavalry reached the Han River; Ying Qianzhi, prefectural defender of Junzhou, abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen, the Jin besieged Suizhou and Zaoyang Army; raiding horsemen reached the Han River; Ying Qianzhi, defender of Jun Prefecture, abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen, a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 楚州鈐轄梁昭祖焚金人糧舟於大清河，京東忠義副都統沈鐸遣兵助之。

translations.literal: Supervisory Controller Liang Zhaozu of Chuzhou burned Jin grain boats on the Daqing River; Shen Duo, Vice Commander-in-Chief of Jingdong loyal volunteers, sent troops to assist.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisory Controller Liang Zhaozu of Chuzhou burned Jin grain boats on the Daqing River; Shen Duo, vice commander of the Jingdong loyal volunteers, sent troops to assist him.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，金人焚湫池堡而去。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day dingchou, the Jin burned Qiu Pond Stockade and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day dingchou, the Jin burned Qiu Pond Stockade and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 戊子，利州統制王逸等率忠義人復皂郊，金副統軍完顏贇、包長壽遁去，沔州軍士郭雄追斬贇首，長壽僅以身免。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Wang Yi and others of Lizhou led loyal volunteers to recover Zaojiao; Jin Vice Commanders Wanyan Yun and Bao Changshou fled; Guo Xiong of Minzhou army pursued and beheaded Yun; Changshou barely escaped with his life.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi, Wang Yi and others of Lizhou led loyal volunteers to recover Zaojiao; Jin vice commanders Wanyan Yun and Bao Changshou fled; Guo Xiong of the Min Prefecture army pursued and beheaded Yun, while Changshou barely escaped with his life.

sentences.zh: 己丑，沔州都統劉昌祖至皂郊。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Liu Changzu, Commander-in-Chief of Minzhou, arrived at Zaojiao.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou, Liu Changzu, Commander-in-Chief of Min Prefecture, arrived at Zaojiao.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，忠義人十萬余出攻秦州，官軍繼進，至赤谷口，王逸傳昌祖之命退師，且放散忠義人，軍大潰。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, more than one hundred thousand loyal volunteers marched to attack Qinzhou; regular troops followed; at Chigu Pass, Wang Yi relayed Liu Changzu's order to withdraw and dispersed the volunteers; the army collapsed in great rout.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao, more than one hundred thousand loyal volunteers marched out to attack Qin Prefecture, with regular troops following behind; at Chigu Pass, Wang Yi relayed Liu Changzu's order to withdraw and dispersed the volunteers, and the army broke in catastrophic rout.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，包長壽合長安、鳳翔之衆，復攻皂郊，遂趨西和州。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Bao Changshou combined forces from Chang'an and Fengxiang, attacked Zaojiao again, then pressed toward Xihe Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi, Bao Changshou combined the forces of Chang'an and Fengxiang, attacked Zaojiao again, and then pressed toward Xihe Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是日，鎮江忠義統制彭惟誠等敗於泗州。

translations.literal: That same day, Peng Weicheng and others, controllers of Zhenjiang loyal volunteers, were defeated at Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That same day, Peng Weicheng and other controllers of the Zhenjiang loyal volunteers were defeated at Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，劉昌祖焚西和州遁，守臣楊克家棄城去。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Liu Changzu burned Xihe Prefecture and fled; defending official Yang Kejia abandoned the city.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen, Liu Changzu burned Xihe Prefecture and fled; defending official Yang Kejia abandoned the city.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，金人破西和州。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the Jin took Xihe Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu, the Jin captured Xihe Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，劉昌祖焚成州遁，守臣羅仲甲棄城去。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day jiachen, Liu Changzu burned Chengzhou and fled; defending official Luo Zhongjia abandoned the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jiachen, Liu Changzu burned Cheng Prefecture and fled; defending official Luo Zhongjia abandoned the city.

sentences.zh: 是日，金人去西和州。

translations.literal: That same day, the Jin left Xihe Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That same day, the Jin withdrew from Xihe Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊申，命四川增印錢引五百萬以給軍費。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Sichuan was ordered to print an additional five million in paper money to fund military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen, Sichuan was ordered to print an additional five million in paper money to pay military expenses.

sentences.zh: 階州守臣侯頤棄城去。

translations.literal: Defending official Hou Yi of Jiezhou abandoned the city.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Yi, defender of Jie Prefecture, abandoned the city.

sentences.zh: 是日，金人去成州。

translations.literal: That same day, the Jin left Chengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That same day, the Jin withdrew from Cheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊午，金人復犯大散關，守將王立遁。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, the Jin again attacked Dasanguan; defending general Wang Li fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu, the Jin again attacked Dasanguan; defending general Wang Li fled.

sentences.zh: 己未，金人犯黃牛堡，興元都統吳政拒退之。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, the Jin attacked Huangniu Stockade; Commander-in-Chief Wu Zheng of Xingyuan repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei, the Jin attacked Huangniu Stockade; Commander-in-Chief Wu Zheng of Xingyuan repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，政至大散關，執王立斬之。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Zheng reached Dasanguan, seized Wang Li, and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai, Wu Zheng reached Dasanguan, seized Wang Li, and executed him.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥，命四川制置司招進忠義人。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day yihai, the Sichuan Commissioner's Office was ordered to recruit loyal volunteers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day yihai, the Sichuan Commissioner's Office was ordered to recruit loyal volunteers.

sentences.zh: 癸未，蚩尤旗見，其長竟天。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, the Chiyou banner comet appeared, its tail stretching across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei, the Chiyou-banner comet appeared, its tail spanning the heavens.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔侍從、台諫、兩省官集議平戎、禦戎、和戎三策。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, an edict convened attendants, remonstrance censors, and officials of the two provincial secretariats to deliberate on three strategies: pacifying the barbarians, defending against them, and making peace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai, an edict convened palace attendants, remonstrance censors, and officials of the two provincial secretariats to debate three policies: pacifying the enemy, defending against them, and making peace.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，申嚴試法官七等之制。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, the seven-grade system for judicial examination officials was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen, the seven-rank system for judicial examination officials was strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，詔湖州振恤被水貧民。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day xinyou, an edict ordered Huzhou to relieve poor victims of flooding.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day xinyou, an edict ordered Huzhou to relieve the poor who had suffered from flooding.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，奪知天水軍黃炎孫三官、辰州居住。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day guiyou, Huang Yansun, military prefect of Tianshui Army, was stripped of three ranks and confined to Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day guiyou, Huang Yansun, prefect of Tianshui Army, was stripped of three ranks and ordered to reside at Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，修《孝宗寶訓》。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, editing of Emperor Xiaozong's Precious Instructions was undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou, work began on revising Emperor Xiaozong's Precious Instructions.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，蠲四川關外諸州稅役。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, taxes and corvée of all prefectures outside the Sichuan passes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao, taxes and corvée labor in all prefectures beyond the Sichuan passes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲午，蠲光州民兵戰死之家稅役。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, taxes and corvée of families whose militia had died in battle in Guangzhou were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu, taxes and corvée labor were remitted for families in Guang Prefecture whose militiamen had died in battle.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，朝獻于景靈宮。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jimao, the emperor made offerings at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day jimao, the emperor made offerings at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，朝鄉於太廟。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, the emperor performed the village rite at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen, the emperor performed court rites at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛己，合祭天地於明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, heaven and earth were jointly sacrificed at the Bright Hall; a general amnesty was declared.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi, heaven and earth were jointly sacrificed at the Bright Hall, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，安定郡王伯渾薨。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Prince of Anding Jun, Bo Hun, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao, Bo Hun, Prince of Anding, died.

sentences.zh: 丙申，興元都統吳政、利州副都統張威各進三官。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Wu Zheng, Commander-in-Chief of Xingyuan, and Zhang Wei, Vice Commander-in-Chief of Lizhou, were each promoted three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen, Wu Zheng, Commander-in-Chief of Xingyuan, and Zhang Wei, Vice Commander-in-Chief of Lizhou, were each promoted three ranks.

sentences.zh: 劉昌祖奪五官、韶州安置。

translations.literal: Liu Changzu was stripped of five ranks and assigned to Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Changzu was stripped of five ranks and ordered to reside at Shao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，羅仲甲、楊克家、侯頤並奪三官，仲甲常德府、克家道州、頤撫州居住。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day bingwu, Luo Zhongjia, Yang Kejia, and Hou Yi were each stripped of three ranks; Zhongjia confined to Changde Prefecture, Kejia to Daozhou, Yi to Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the day bingwu, Luo Zhongjia, Yang Kejia, and Hou Yi were each stripped of three ranks; Zhongjia was ordered to reside at Changde Prefecture, Kejia at Dao Prefecture, and Yi at Fu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊午，大風。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, great winds blew.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu, fierce winds arose.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，修盱眙軍城。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Xuyi Army city walls were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu, the walls of Xuyi Army were repaired.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，金人攻安豐軍之黃口灘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renshen, Jin forces attacked Huangkou Beach of Anfeng Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day renshen, Jin forces attacked Huangkou Beach in Anfeng Army.

sentences.zh: 是月，陝西人張羽來歸。

translations.literal: That month, Zhang Yu of Shaanxi came over in submission.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Zhang Yu of Shaanxi came over to the Song side.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月戊辰朔，召董居誼詣行在。

translations.literal: In spring of the twelfth year, first month, first day wuchen, Dong Juyi was summoned to the temporary court.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the twelfth year (1219), on the first day wuchen, Dong Juyi was summoned to the mobile court.

sentences.zh: 以新利州路安撫使聶子述爲四川制置使。

translations.literal: Nie Zishu, newly appointed Pacification Commissioner of Lizhou Circuit, was made Commissioner of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Nie Zishu, newly appointed Pacification Commissioner of Lizhou Circuit, was made Commissioner of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，金人犯湫池堡，守將石宣拒退之。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Jin forces attacked Qiu Pond Stockade; defending general Shi Xuan repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen, Jin forces attacked Qiu Pond Stockade; defending general Shi Xuan repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 甲申，金人攻白環堡，守將董炤拒退之。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Jin forces attacked Baihuan Stockade; defending general Dong Zhao repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen, Jin forces attacked Baihuan Stockade; defending general Dong Zhao repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 戊子，金人犯成州，沔州都統張威自西和州退守仙人原。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Jin forces attacked Chengzhou; Zhang Wei, Commander-in-Chief of Minzhou, withdrew from Xihe Prefecture to defend Xianren Plain.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi, Jin forces attacked Cheng Prefecture; Zhang Wei, Commander-in-Chief of Min Prefecture, withdrew from Xihe Prefecture to hold Xianren Plain.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，金人犯隨州、棗陽軍，又破信陽軍之二砦，京西諸將引兵拒之。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Jin forces attacked Suizhou and Zaoyang Army, also overran two stockades of Xinyang Army; generals of Jingxi led troops to resist.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin, Jin forces attacked Suizhou and Zaoyang Army and also overran two stockades of Xinyang Army; the generals of Jingxi led troops to resist them.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，金人犯西和州，守臣趙彥呐設伏以待之，殲其衆乃還。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Jin forces attacked Xihe Prefecture; defending official Zhao Yan'a set an ambush, annihilated their forces, then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao, Jin forces attacked Xihe Prefecture; defending official Zhao Yan'a laid an ambush, annihilated their force, and then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 金人犯安豐軍，建康都統許俊遣將卻之。

translations.literal: Jin forces attacked Anfeng Army; Xu Jun, Commander-in-Chief of Jiankang, sent generals who repulsed them.
translations.idiomatic: Jin forces attacked Anfeng Army; Xu Jun, Commander-in-Chief of Jiankang, sent generals who drove them back.

sentences.zh: 金人焚成州，犯河池，守將張斌遁去。

translations.literal: Jin forces burned Chengzhou, attacked Hechi; defending general Zhang Bin fled.
translations.idiomatic: Jin forces burned Cheng Prefecture and attacked Hechi; defending general Zhang Bin fled.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，金人圍安豐軍及光州，攻光化軍，破鄖山縣，進副均州。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Jin forces besieged Anfeng Army and Guangzhou, attacked Guanghua Army, overran Yunyang County, and advanced toward Junzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi, Jin forces besieged Anfeng Army and Guang Prefecture, attacked Guanghua Army, overran Yunyang County, and pressed toward Jun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲午，破鳳州，守臣雷雲棄城去，金人夷其城。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, they took Fengzhou; defending official Lei Yun abandoned the city; the Jin razed it.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu, they captured Feng Prefecture; defending official Lei Yun abandoned the city, and the Jin razed it.

sentences.zh: 乙未，興元都統吳政及金人戰於黃牛堡，死之。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Wu Zheng, Commander-in-Chief of Xingyuan, fought Jin forces at Huangniu Stockade and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei, Wu Zheng, Commander-in-Chief of Xingyuan, fought the Jin at Huangniu Stockade and was killed.

sentences.zh: 金人乘勝攻武休關。

translations.literal: The Jin pressed their victory to attack Wuxiu Pass.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin pressed their advantage and attacked Wuxiu Pass.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌朔，金人破光山縣。

translations.literal: In the second month, first day wuxu, the Jin took Guangshan County.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the first day wuxu, the Jin captured Guangshan County.

sentences.zh: 太白晝見。

translations.literal: Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Venus appeared in the daytime sky.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，金人圍棗陽軍，京湖制置使趙方遣統制扈再興救之，不克進而還。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Jin forces besieged Zaoyang Army; Zhao Fang, Commissioner of Jing and Hu, dispatched Controller Hu Zaixing to relieve it, but he could not advance and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin, Jin forces besieged Zaoyang Army; Zhao Fang, Commissioner of Jing and Hu, sent Controller Hu Zaixing to the rescue, but he failed to break through and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，金人破武休關，興元都統李貴遁還，利州路提刑、權興元府事趙希昔棄城去。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, the Jin broke Wuxiu Pass; Li Gui, Commander-in-Chief of Xingyuan, fled back; Zhao Xixi, Circuit Intendant of Lizhou and acting prefect of Xingyuan, abandoned the city.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao, the Jin overran Wuxiu Pass; Li Gui, Commander-in-Chief of Xingyuan, fled back; Zhao Xixi, Circuit Intendant of Lizhou and acting prefect of Xingyuan, abandoned the city.

sentences.zh: 丁未，金人破興元府。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, the Jin took Xingyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei, the Jin captured Xingyuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊申，金人攻棗陽軍。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Jin forces attacked Zaoyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen, Jin forces attacked Zaoyang Army.

sentences.zh: 己酉，遣殿前司軍八千人防捍江面。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, eight thousand troops of the Palace Command were dispatched to defend the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou, eight thousand troops of the Palace Command were sent to guard the Yangtze front.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以曾從龍同知樞密院事兼江、淮宣撫使，權吏部尚書任希夷簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Zeng Conglong was made Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrently Jiang-Huai Pacification Commissioner; Ren Xiyi, Acting Minister of Personnel, was made Deputy Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu, Zeng Conglong was appointed Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and concurrently Jiang-Huai Pacification Commissioner; Ren Xiyi, Acting Minister of Personnel, was made Deputy Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，金人破大安軍，守臣李文子棄城去。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, the Jin took Da'an Army; defending official Li Wenzi abandoned the city.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai, the Jin overran Da'an Army; defending official Li Wenzi abandoned the city.

sentences.zh: 金人犯洋州，守臣蔡晉卿遣兵拒之，不克，洋州破。

translations.literal: Jin forces attacked Yang Prefecture; defending official Cai Jinqing sent troops to resist but failed, and Yang Prefecture fell.
translations.idiomatic: Jin forces attacked Yang Prefecture; defending official Cai Jinqing sent troops to resist them but failed, and Yang Prefecture fell.

sentences.zh: 壬子，四川制置使董居誼自利州遁。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Dong Juyi, Commissioner of Sichuan, fled from Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi, Dong Juyi, Commissioner of Sichuan, fled from Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 沔州都統張威遣統制石宣等邀擊金人于大安軍，大破之，獲其將巴土魯安，金人遂去興元府。

translations.literal: Zhang Wei, Commander-in-Chief of Min Prefecture, dispatched Controllers Shi Xuan and others to intercept Jin forces at Da'an Army, routing them greatly and capturing their general Batuluan; the Jin then left Xingyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wei, Commander-in-Chief of Min Prefecture, sent Controllers Shi Xuan and others to ambush the Jin at Da'an Army, inflicting a crushing defeat and capturing their general Batuluan; the Jin then withdrew from Xingyuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，金人去洋州。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the Jin left Yang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen, the Jin withdrew from Yang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，京湖制置使趙方遣統制扈再興等引兵三萬餘人出攻唐、鄧二州，隨州忠義統領劉世興等引兵攻唐州。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Zhao Fang, Commissioner of Jing and Hu, dispatched Hu Zaixing and others with more than thirty thousand troops to attack Tang and Deng prefectures; Liu Shixing and other leaders of Suizhou loyal volunteers led troops to attack Tang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi, Zhao Fang, Commissioner of Jing and Hu, sent Hu Zaixing and others with more than thirty thousand troops to attack Tang and Deng prefectures; Liu Shixing and other leaders of the Suizhou loyal volunteers led troops against Tang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲子，金人去棗陽軍。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the Jin left Zaoyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi, the Jin withdrew from Zaoyang Army.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，夏人復以書來四川，議夾攻金人，利州路安撫丁焴許之。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, the Western Xia again sent a letter to Sichuan proposing a joint attack on the Jin; Ding Huang, Pacification Commissioner of Lizhou Circuit, agreed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou, the Western Xia again wrote to Sichuan proposing a joint attack on the Jin; Ding Huang, Pacification Commissioner of Lizhou Circuit, agreed.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，以鄭昭先知樞密院事，曾從龍參知政事。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day jisi, Zheng Zhaoxian was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Zeng Conglong was made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day jisi, Zheng Zhaoxian was appointed Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Zeng Conglong was made Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，金人復入洋州，焚其城而去。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the Jin re-entered Yang Prefecture, burned the city, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou, the Jin re-entered Yang Prefecture, burned the city, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，興元軍士權興等作亂，犯巴州，守臣秦季槱棄城去。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, soldiers of Xingyuan led by Quan Xing and others mutinied, attacked Bazhou, and defending official Qin Jiyu abandoned the city.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai, soldiers of Xingyuan led by Quan Xing and others mutinied, attacked Ba Prefecture, and defending official Qin Jiyu abandoned the city.

sentences.zh: 鄂州統制劉世榮會兵攻唐州。

translations.literal: Liu Shirong, Controller of Ezhou, joined forces to attack Tang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shirong, Controller of Ezhou, combined forces to attack Tang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai, Venus appeared in the daytime sky.

sentences.zh: 權興等降。

translations.literal: Quan Xing and others surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Quan Xing and his followers surrendered.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，雨土。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, dust fell like rain.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi, dust rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 甲午，金人自盱眙退師。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the Jin withdrew their army from Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu, the Jin army withdrew from Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 閏月己未，追雷雲三官、梅州安置。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day jiwei, Lei Yun was posthumously stripped of three ranks and ordered to reside at Meizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the day jiwei, Lei Yun was posthumously stripped of three ranks and ordered to reside at Mei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，贈吳政爲右武大夫、忠州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Wu Zheng was posthumously enfeoffed as Right Martial Grandee and Prefect of Zhongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou, Wu Zheng was posthumously enfeoffed as Right Martial Grandee and Prefect of Zhong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔撫諭四川官軍、忠義人。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, an edict comforted and instructed the regular troops and loyal volunteers of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu, an edict was issued to reassure and instruct the regular troops and loyal volunteers of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，興元軍士張福、莫簡等作亂，以紅巾爲號。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, soldiers of Xingyuan, Zhang Fu, Mo Jian, and others mutinied, taking red scarves as their sign.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai, Zhang Fu, Mo Jian, and other soldiers of Xingyuan mutinied under the banner of red scarves.

sentences.zh: 是春，金人圍安豐軍、滁、濠、光三州。

translations.literal: That spring, the Jin besieged Anfeng Army and the three prefectures of Chu, Hao, and Guang.
translations.idiomatic: That spring, the Jin besieged Anfeng Army and the three prefectures of Chu, Hao, and Guang.

sentences.zh: 江、淮制置使李玨命池州都統武師道、忠義軍統制陳孝忠救之，皆不克進。

translations.literal: Li Jue, Commissioner of the Jiang and Huai regions, ordered Wu Shidao, Commander-in-Chief of Chuzhou, and Chen Xiaozhong, Controller of the loyal volunteers, to relieve them; none could advance.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jue, Commissioner of the Jiang and Huai circuits, ordered Wu Shidao, Commander-in-Chief of Chuzhou, and Chen Xiaozhong, Controller of the loyal volunteers, to the rescue, but none of them could break through.

sentences.zh: 金人遂分兵自光州犯黃州之麻城，自濠州犯和州之石磧，自盱眙軍犯滁州之全椒、來安及揚州之天長、真州之六合。

translations.literal: The Jin then divided their forces: from Guang Prefecture they attacked Macheng in Huang Prefecture; from Hao Prefecture they attacked Shiji in He Prefecture; from Xuyi Army they attacked Quanjiao and Lai'an in Chu Prefecture, Tianchang in Yang Prefecture, and Liuhe in Zhen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin then divided their forces: from Guang Prefecture they struck Macheng in Huang Prefecture; from Hao Prefecture they struck Shiji in He Prefecture; from Xuyi Army they struck Quanjiao and Lai'an in Chu Prefecture, Tianchang in Yang Prefecture, and Liuhe in Zhen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 淮南流民渡江避亂，諸城悉閉。

translations.literal: Refugees of Huainan crossed the Yangtze to escape the turmoil; all cities closed their gates.
translations.idiomatic: Refugees from Huainan crossed the Yangtze to escape the turmoil, and cities everywhere shut their gates.

sentences.zh: 金人遊騎數百至東採石、楊林渡，建康大震。

translations.literal: Several hundred Jin raiding horsemen reached East Caishi and Yanglin Ford; Jiankang was greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Several hundred Jin raiding horsemen reached East Caishi and Yanglin Ford, throwing Jiankang into alarm.

sentences.zh: 京東總管李全自楚州、忠義總轄季先自漣水軍各引兵來援，金人乃解去。

translations.literal: Li Quan, overall commander of Jingdong, led troops from Chuzhou and Ji Xian, overall controller of the loyal volunteers, led troops from Lianshui Army to the rescue; the Jin then lifted the siege and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Li Quan, overall commander of Jingdong, led troops from Chuzhou, and Ji Xian, overall controller of the loyal volunteers, led troops from Lianshui Army to the rescue; the Jin then lifted the siege and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 全追擊，敗之于曹家莊，獲其貴將。

translations.literal: Quan pursued them, defeated them at Caojia Village, and captured a high-ranking Jin general.
translations.idiomatic: Quan pursued them, defeated them at Caojia Village, and captured a high-ranking Jin general.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚午，張福入利州，四川制置使聶子述遁，殺總領財賦楊九鼎。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day gengwu, Zhang Fu entered Lizhou; Nie Zishu, Commissioner of Sichuan, fled and killed Yang Jiuding, Director of Fiscal Revenues.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the day gengwu, Zhang Fu entered Li Prefecture; Nie Zishu, Commissioner of Sichuan, fled and killed Yang Jiuding, Director of Fiscal Revenues.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，張福掠閬州，丁亥，掠果州。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Zhang Fu plundered Langzhou; on the day dinghai, he plundered Guozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, Zhang Fu plundered Lang Prefecture; on the day dinghai, he plundered Guo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，曾從龍罷。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Zeng Conglong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi, Zeng Conglong was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 以鄭昭先兼參知政事，崇信軍節度使、開府儀同三司、萬壽觀使安丙爲四川宣撫使。

translations.literal: Zheng Zhaoxian was additionally made Vice Grand Councilor; An Bing, Military Commissioner of Chongxin Army, Grand Preceptor with the Honours of the Three Dukes, and Director of Wanshou Abbey, was made Sichuan Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Zhaoxian was additionally made Vice Grand Councilor; An Bing, Military Commissioner of Chongxin Army, Grand Preceptor with the Honours of the Three Dukes, and Director of Wanshou Abbey, was appointed Sichuan Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 董居誼落職，奪三官。

translations.literal: Dong Juyi was removed from office and stripped of three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Juyi was removed from office and stripped of three ranks.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未朔，召聶子述詣行在。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, first day yiwei, Nie Zishu was summoned to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the first day yiwei, Nie Zishu was summoned to the mobile court.

sentences.zh: 張福薄遂寧府，潼川府路轉運判官、權府事程遇孫棄城遁。

translations.literal: Zhang Fu pressed Suining Prefecture; Cheng Yusun, Transport Judge of Tongchuan Circuit and acting prefect, abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fu pressed Suining Prefecture; Cheng Yusun, Transport Judge of Tongchuan Circuit and acting prefect, abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，減兩淮、荊襄、湖北、利州路沿邊諸州雜犯死罪囚，釋流以下，仍蠲今年租稅。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, death sentences for miscellaneous offenses in border prefectures of the two Huai circuits, Jingxiang, Hubei, and Lizhou were commuted; exiles and lesser punishments were released, and this year's taxes and corvée were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou, death sentences for miscellaneous offenses in the border prefectures of the two Huai circuits, Jingxiang, Hubei, and Lizhou were commuted; those sentenced to exile or lesser punishments were released, and this year's taxes and corvée were remitted.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太學生何處恬等伏闕上書，以工部尚書胡榘欲和金人，請誅之以謝天下。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Imperial University students He Chutian and others prostrated themselves at the palace gate and submitted a memorial, charging that Hu Ju, Minister of Works, wished to make peace with the Jin and asking that he be executed to satisfy the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai, Imperial University students He Chutian and others prostrated themselves at the palace gate and submitted a memorial, charging that Hu Ju, Minister of Works, wished to make peace with the Jin and asking that he be executed as an act of atonement to the realm.

sentences.zh: 張福入遂寧府，焚其城。

translations.literal: Zhang Fu entered Suining Prefecture and burned the city.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fu entered Suining Prefecture and burned the city.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，四川宣撫司命沔州都統張威引兵捕福。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, the Sichuan Pacification Commission ordered Zhang Wei, Commander-in-Chief of Min Prefecture, to lead troops to capture Fu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin, the Sichuan Pacification Commission ordered Zhang Wei, Commander-in-Chief of Min Prefecture, to lead troops to capture Zhang Fu.

sentences.zh: 戊午，福入普州，守臣張已之棄城遁。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Fu entered Puzhou; defending official Zhang Yizhi abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu, Zhang Fu entered Pu Prefecture; defending official Zhang Yizhi abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔侍從、兩省、台諫各舉文武可用之才二三人。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, an edict ordered palace attendants, officials of the two provincial secretariats, and remonstrance censors each to recommend two or three persons of civil or military talent fit for service.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai, an edict required palace attendants, officials of the two provincial secretariats, and remonstrance censors each to recommend two or three persons of civil or military talent fit for service.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，張福屯普州之茗山。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day wuchen, Zhang Fu encamped at Mingshan in Pu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day wuchen, Zhang Fu encamped at Mingshan in Pu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚午，張威引兵至。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Zhang Wei led troops there.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu, Zhang Wei led his troops there.

sentences.zh: 丙子，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, Venus appeared in the daytime sky.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，西川地震。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, western Sichuan suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi, western Sichuan was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 太白晝見。

translations.literal: Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: Venus appeared in the daytime sky.

sentences.zh: 癸未，張福請降，乙酉，張威執之，歸於宣撫司。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Zhang Fu requested surrender; on the day yiyou, Zhang Wei seized him and sent him to the Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei, Zhang Fu asked to surrender; on the day yiyou, Zhang Wei seized him and delivered him to the Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，嗣濮王不嫖薨。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Bu Piao, heir to the Prince of Pu, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai, Bu Piao, heir to the Prince of Pu, died.

sentences.zh: 金國招諭李全等，不聽。

translations.literal: The Jin state summoned and instructed Li Quan and others; they did not heed it.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin court summoned and instructed Li Quan and others, but they refused to listen.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，太白經天。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Venus crossed the heavens.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao, Venus traversed the sky.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，丁焴復以書約夏國攻金人。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Ding Huang again wrote to arrange with the Western Xia an attack on the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi, Ding Huang again wrote to the Western Xia to arrange a joint attack on the Jin.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙申，張福伏誅。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day bingshen, Zhang Fu was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day bingshen, Zhang Fu was executed.

sentences.zh: 復奪董居誼二官、永州居住。

translations.literal: Dong Juyi was again stripped of two ranks and ordered to reside at Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Juyi was again stripped of two ranks and ordered to reside at Yong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚子，張威捕賊衆一千三百餘人誅之，莫簡自殺，紅巾賊悉平。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Zhang Wei captured more than thirteen hundred bandits and executed them; Mo Jian killed himself; the red-scarf bandits were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi, Zhang Wei captured more than thirteen hundred bandits and executed them; Mo Jian killed himself, and the red-scarf rebels were completely suppressed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，李全引兵至齊州，知州王贇以城降。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Li Quan led troops to Qizhou; Prefect Wang Yun surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai, Li Quan led troops to Qi Prefecture; Prefect Wang Yun surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 八月戊辰，復合利州東、西路爲一。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day wuchen, the eastern and western circuits of Lizhou were reunified as one.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day wuchen, the eastern and western circuits of Lizhou were reunified as one.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，罷江、淮制置司，置沿江、淮東西制置司。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day bingwu, the Jiang-Huai Commissioner's Office was abolished and offices for commissioners along the river and for the eastern and western Huai regions were established.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day bingwu, the Jiang-Huai Commissioner's Office was abolished and separate offices were established for commissioners along the Yangtze and for the eastern and western Huai regions.

sentences.zh: 以寶文閣待制李大東爲沿江制置使，淮南轉運判官趙善湘爲主管淮西制置司公事，淮東提刑賈涉爲主管淮東制置司公事兼節制京東、河北路軍馬。

translations.literal: Li Dadong, Awaiting Drafting at the Baowen Pavilion, was made Commissioner along the River; Zhao Shanxiang, Transport Judge of Huainan, was made chief administrator of the Huai West Commissioner's Office; Jia She, Circuit Intendant of Huai East, was made chief administrator of the Huai East Commissioner's Office and concurrently controller of military forces of Jingdong and Hebei circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Li Dadong, Awaiting Drafting at the Baowen Pavilion, was appointed Commissioner along the Yangtze; Zhao Shanxiang, Transport Judge of Huainan, was made chief administrator of the Huai West Commissioner's Office; Jia She, Circuit Intendant of Huai East, was made chief administrator of the Huai East Commissioner's Office and concurrently controller of military forces of the Jingdong and Hebei circuits.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，進封楊次山爲會稽郡王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day xinhai, Yang Cishan was advanced in rank to Prince of Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day xinhai, Yang Cishan was advanced in rank to Prince of Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，京東節制司言復京東、河北二府九州四十縣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day renshen, the Jingdong Control Office reported the recovery of two prefectures, nine prefectures, and forty counties in Jingdong and Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day renshen, the Jingdong Control Office reported the recovery of two superior prefectures, nine prefectures, and forty counties in Jingdong and Hebei.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，築興元府城。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the walls of Xingyuan Prefecture were built.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai, the walls of Xingyuan Prefecture were rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，雅州蠻入盧山縣。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, tribal forces of Yazhou entered Lushan County.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, tribal forces from Yazhou entered Lushan County.

sentences.zh: 己卯，四川宣撫司遣兵取洮州，召諸將議出師，招諭中原豪傑。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, the Sichuan Pacification Commission dispatched troops to take Taozhou, summoned generals to discuss campaigning, and summoned heroes of the Central Plains.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao, the Sichuan Pacification Commission dispatched troops to take Tao Prefecture, summoned generals to discuss campaigning, and called on heroes of the Central Plains to rise.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，蠻焚碉門砦，邊丁大敗。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, tribesmen burned Diaomen Stockade and frontier militia suffered a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi, tribesmen burned Diaomen Stockade and the frontier militia suffered a crushing defeat.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，金人犯鳳州之長橋。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Jin forces attacked Changqiao in Feng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou, Jin forces attacked Changqiao in Feng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，四川宣撫司命罷洮州之師。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the Sichuan Pacification Commission ordered the campaign against Taozhou halted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai, the Sichuan Pacification Commission ordered the campaign against Tao Prefecture halted.

sentences.zh: 己丑，京湖置司遣統制扈再興等引兵六萬人，分二道出境。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the Jinghu Commissioner's Office dispatched Hu Zaixing and others with sixty thousand troops in two columns across the border.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou, the Jinghu Commissioner's Office sent Hu Zaixing and others with sixty thousand troops in two columns across the border.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，賞茗山捕賊功。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, rewards were granted for the merit of capturing bandits at Mingshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin, rewards were granted for the merit of capturing the bandits at Mingshan.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月丁酉，扈再興引兵攻鄧州，鄂州都統許國攻唐州，不克而還。

translations.literal: In spring of the thirteenth year, first month, on the day dingyou, Hu Zaixing led troops to attack Deng Prefecture; Xu Guo, Commander-in-Chief of Ezhou, attacked Tang Prefecture; neither succeeded and they returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the thirteenth year, on the day dingyou, Hu Zaixing led troops against Deng Prefecture and Xu Guo, Commander-in-Chief of Ezhou, attacked Tang Prefecture; neither succeeded and they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 金人追之，遂攻樊城，趙方督諸將拒退之。

translations.literal: The Jin pursued them, then attacked Fancheng; Zhao Fang supervised the generals in repulsing them.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin pursued them, then attacked Fancheng; Zhao Fang directed the generals in driving them back.

sentences.zh: 己亥，雅州蠻復掠盧山縣，遣兵討之。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, tribal forces of Yazhou again plundered Lushan County; troops were dispatched to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai, tribal forces from Yazhou again plundered Lushan County, and troops were sent to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命不淩爲嗣濮王。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Bu Ling was appointed heir to the Prince of Pu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou, Bu Ling was appointed heir to the Prince of Pu.

sentences.zh: 戊午，夏人復以書來四川，議夾攻金人。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, the Western Xia again sent a letter to Sichuan proposing a joint attack on the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu, the Western Xia again wrote to Sichuan proposing a joint attack on the Jin.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯朔，雨土。

translations.literal: In the third month, first day xinmao, dust fell like rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the first day xinmao, dust rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，黎州土丁叛，遣兵討之。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, native militia of Lizhou rebelled; troops were dispatched to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi, native militia of Li Prefecture rebelled, and troops were sent to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申朔，淮東制置賈涉招諭山東、兩河豪傑。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, first day gengshen, Jia She, Commissioner of Huai East, summoned and instructed heroes of Shandong and the two He regions.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the first day gengshen, Jia She, Commissioner of Huai East, issued calls to heroes of Shandong and the two He regions.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅朔，雅州蠻降。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, first day gengyin, tribal forces of Yazhou surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the first day gengyin, the tribal forces of Yazhou surrendered.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，史彌遠等上《玉牒》及《三祖下第七世宗藩慶系錄》。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Shi Miyuan and others presented the 《Jade Genealogy》 and the 《Record of the Seventh-Generation Branch of the Three Ancestors' Princely Houses》.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu, Shi Miyuan and others presented the 《Jade Genealogy》 and the 《Record of the Seventh-Generation Branch of the Three Ancestors' Princely Houses》.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，賜禮部進士劉渭以下四百七十有五人及第、出身。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day guiyou, four hundred and seventy-five Jinshi graduates including Liu Wei of the Ministry of Rites were granted metropolitan degrees and appointment qualifications.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day guiyou, four hundred and seventy-five graduates of the metropolitan examination, including Liu Wei of the Ministry of Rites, were granted jinshi degrees and official appointment.

sentences.zh: 加安丙少保。

translations.literal: An Bing was promoted to Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: An Bing was promoted to Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以李全爲左武衛大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Li Quan was made General of the Left Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, Li Quan was appointed General of the Left Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以季先爲果州團練使、漣水軍忠義副都統，命赴樞密院議事，未至，殺之。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Ji Xian was made Militia Commissioner of Guozhou and Vice Commander-in-Chief of the Lianshui loyal volunteers; he was ordered to the Bureau of Military Affairs to discuss affairs, but before he arrived he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu, Ji Xian was made Militia Commissioner of Guo Prefecture and Vice Commander-in-Chief of the Lianshui loyal volunteers and ordered to the Bureau of Military Affairs to discuss affairs, but before he arrived he was killed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，以京東、河北諸州守臣空名官告付京東、河北節制司，以待豪傑之來歸者。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day wuxu, blank appointment patents for prefects of Jingdong and Hebei were given to the Jingdong-Hebei Control Office to await heroes who came over in submission.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day wuxu, blank appointment patents for prefects of Jingdong and Hebei were given to the Jingdong-Hebei Control Office to await heroes who came over to the Song side.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以任希夷兼參知政事。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Ren Xiyi was additionally made Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu, Ren Xiyi was additionally made Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，四川宣撫司招黎人土丁，降之。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the Sichuan Pacification Commission recruited Li native militia and received their surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen, the Sichuan Pacification Commission recruited Li native militia and received their surrender.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，皇太子詢薨，諡曰景獻。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day guihai, Crown Prince Xun died; his posthumous title was Jingxian.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day guihai, Crown Prince Xun died and was given the posthumous title Jingxian.

sentences.zh: 壬申，安丙遺夏人書，定議夾攻金人。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, An Bing sent a letter to the Western Xia fixing agreement on a joint attack on the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen, An Bing sent a letter to the Western Xia confirming agreement on a joint attack on the Jin.

sentences.zh: 癸未，四川宣撫司命利州統制王仕信引兵赴熙、鞏州會夏人，遂傳檄招諭陝西五路官吏軍民。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, the Sichuan Pacification Commission ordered Wang Shixin, Controller of Lizhou, to lead troops to Xi and Gong prefectures to join the Western Xia, then circulated a proclamation summoning officials, soldiers, and civilians of the five Shaanxi circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei, the Sichuan Pacification Commission ordered Wang Shixin, Controller of Li Prefecture, to lead troops to Xi and Gong prefectures to join the Western Xia, then circulated a proclamation calling on officials, soldiers, and civilians of the five Shaanxi circuits.

sentences.zh: 甲申，復海州，以將作監丞徐晞稷知州事。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Haizhou was recovered; Xu Xiji, Director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings, was made prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen, Hai Prefecture was recovered, and Xu Xiji, Director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings, was appointed prefect.

sentences.zh: 盱眙將石珪叛入漣水軍，詔以珪爲漣水忠義軍統轄。

translations.literal: Shi Gui, a general of Xuyi, defected to Lianshui Army; an edict appointed Gui overall controller of the Lianshui loyal volunteers.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Gui, a general of Xuyi, defected to Lianshui Army; an edict appointed him overall controller of the Lianshui loyal volunteers.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，夏人引兵圍鞏州，且來趣師。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinmao, the Western Xia led troops to besiege Gong Prefecture and also came to urge the Song army forward.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day xinmao, the Western Xia led troops to besiege Gong Prefecture and also came to urge the Song army forward.

sentences.zh: 甲午，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu, Venus appeared in the daytime sky.

sentences.zh: 王仕信引兵發宕昌。

translations.literal: Wang Shixin led troops out from Dangchang.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shixin led his troops out from Dangchang.

sentences.zh: 乙未，四川宣撫司統制質俊、李寔引兵發下城。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Zhi Jun and Li Shi, Controllers of the Sichuan Pacification Commission, led troops out from Xiacheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei, Zhi Jun and Li Shi, Controllers of the Sichuan Pacification Commission, led their troops out from Xiacheng.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，四川宣撫司命諸將分道進兵，沔州都統張威出天水，利州副都統程信出長道，興元副都統陳立出大散關，興元統制田胃爲宣撫司帳前都統出子午谷，金州副都統陳昱出上津。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the Sichuan Pacification Commission ordered generals to advance by separate routes: Zhang Wei, Commander-in-Chief of Min Prefecture, out from Tianshui; Cheng Xin, Vice Commander-in-Chief of Lizhou, out from Changdao; Chen Li, Vice Commander-in-Chief of Xingyuan, out from Dasanguan; Tian Wei, Controller of Xingyuan serving as Commander-in-Chief before the Pacification Commission's tent, out from Ziwu Valley; Chen Yu, Vice Commander-in-Chief of Jin Prefecture, out from Shangjin.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu, the Sichuan Pacification Commission ordered its generals to advance on separate routes: Zhang Wei, Commander-in-Chief of Min Prefecture, from Tianshui; Cheng Xin, Vice Commander-in-Chief of Li Prefecture, from Changdao; Chen Li, Vice Commander-in-Chief of Xingyuan, from Dasanguan; Tian Wei, Controller of Xingyuan serving as front-line commander for the Pacification Commission, from Ziwu Valley; and Chen Yu, Vice Commander-in-Chief of Jin Prefecture, from Shangjin.

sentences.zh: 己亥，張威下令所部諸將毋得擅進兵。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Zhang Wei ordered the generals under his command not to advance troops without authorization.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai, Zhang Wei ordered the generals under his command not to advance without authorization.

sentences.zh: 庚子，質俊等克來遠鎮。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Zhi Jun and others took Laiyuan Town.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi, Zhi Jun and others captured Laiyuan Town.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，王仕信克鹽川鎮。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Wang Shixin took Yanchuan Town.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou, Wang Shixin captured Yanchuan Town.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，質俊等自來遠鎮進攻定邊城，金人來救，俊等擊破之。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Zhi Jun and others advanced from Laiyuan Town to attack Dingbian City; the Jin came to the rescue and Jun and others defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin, Zhi Jun and others advanced from Laiyuan Town against Dingbian City; when the Jin came to relieve it, they routed them.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，程信、王仕信引兵與夏人會于鞏州城下。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Cheng Xin and Wang Shixin led troops to join the Western Xia below the walls of Gong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi, Cheng Xin and Wang Shixin led their troops to join the Western Xia below the walls of Gong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁未，攻城不克。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, the siege did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei, the assault on the city failed.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，金人犯皂郊堡，沔州統制董炤等與戰，大敗。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Jin forces attacked Zaojiao Stockade; Dong Zhao, Controller of Min Prefecture, and others fought them and suffered a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu, Jin forces attacked Zaojiao Stockade; Dong Zhao, Controller of Min Prefecture, and others fought them and were crushed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，程信及夏人攻鞏州不克，信引兵趨秦州。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Cheng Xin and the Western Xia attacked Gong Prefecture without success; Xin led troops toward Qin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi, Cheng Xin and the Western Xia failed to take Gong Prefecture; Xin then led his troops toward Qin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，夏人自安遠砦退師。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the Western Xia withdrew their army from Anyuan Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen, the Western Xia withdrew from Anyuan Stockade.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳朔，程信邀夏人共攻秦州，夏人不從，信遂自伏羌城引軍還，諸將皆罷兵。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, first day dingsi, Cheng Xin invited the Western Xia to attack Qin Prefecture jointly; they did not agree; Xin then led his army back from Fuxiang City and all generals halted their campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the first day dingsi, Cheng Xin invited the Western Xia to join an attack on Qin Prefecture, but they refused; Xin then withdrew from Fuxiang City and all the generals halted their campaigns.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，程信以四川宣撫司之命，斬王仕信於西和州。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Cheng Xin, by order of the Sichuan Pacification Commission, executed Wang Shixin at Xihe Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin, by order of the Sichuan Pacification Commission, Cheng Xin executed Wang Shixin at Xihe Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 四川宣撫司以張威不進兵，罷其軍職。

translations.literal: The Sichuan Pacification Commission dismissed Zhang Wei from his military post for failing to advance.
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan Pacification Commission removed Zhang Wei from his military post for failing to advance.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，大風。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day gengxu, great winds blew.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day gengxu, fierce winds arose.

sentences.zh: 壬子，臨安府火。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Lin'an Prefecture caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi, a fire broke out in Lin'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，大風。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day wuwu, great winds blew.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day wuwu, fierce winds arose.

sentences.zh: 壬申，漣水忠義軍統轄石珪叛。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Shi Gui, overall controller of the Lianshui loyal volunteers, rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen, Shi Gui, overall controller of the Lianshui loyal volunteers, rebelled.

sentences.zh: 癸未，鎮江副都統翟朝宗以「皇帝恭膺天命之寶」來獻。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Zhai Chaozong, Vice Commander-in-Chief of Zhenjiang, presented the seal "The Emperor Reverently Receives the Mandate of Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei, Zhai Chaozong, Vice Commander-in-Chief of Zhenjiang, presented the imperial seal inscribed "The Emperor Reverently Receives the Mandate of Heaven."

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月丙戌朔，以雪寒，釋大理、三衙、臨安、兩浙諸州杖以下囚。

translations.literal: In spring of the fourteenth year, first month, first day bingxu, owing to snow and cold, prisoners below the cane punishment threshold in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Yamen, Lin'an, and the prefectures of the two Zhe circuits were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the fourteenth year, on the first day bingxu, because of snow and cold, prisoners subject to beating or lesser punishments in the Court of Judicial Review, the Three Yamen, Lin'an, and the prefectures of the two Zhe circuits were released.

sentences.zh: 乙未，地震。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei, the earth quaked.

sentences.zh: 以李全還自山東，賜緡錢六萬。

translations.literal: Because Li Quan returned from Shandong, he was granted sixty thousand strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: Because Li Quan had returned from Shandong, he was granted sixty thousand strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 庚子，立四川運米賞格。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, reward standards for transporting grain in Sichuan were established.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi, reward standards were established for transporting grain in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，金人圍光州。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day wuchen, Jin forces besieged Guang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day wuchen, Jin forces besieged Guang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己巳，金人犯五關。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Jin forces attacked the Five Passes.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi, Jin forces attacked the Five Passes.

sentences.zh: 壬申，金人治舟於團風，弗克濟，遂圍黃州，分兵破諸縣，又遣別將犯漢陽軍。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, the Jin prepared boats at Tuanfeng but could not cross; they then besieged Huang Prefecture, divided forces to overrun the counties, and also sent a separate general to attack Hanyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen, the Jin prepared boats at Tuanfeng but could not cross; they then besieged Huang Prefecture, detached columns to overrun the counties, and also sent a separate general against Hanyang Army.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，李全棄泗州遁，還。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Li Quan abandoned Sizhou and fled, then returned.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, Li Quan abandoned Sizhou and fled, then returned.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔淮東、京湖諸路應援淮西，沿江制置司防守江面，權殿前司職事馮榯將兵駐鄂州，京東忠義都統李全將兵救蘄、黃，榯不果行。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, an edict ordered the Huai East and Jinghu circuits to reinforce Huai West; the Commissioner along the River was to defend the Yangtze; Feng Zhen, Acting Director of the Palace Command, was to station troops at Ezhou; Li Quan, Commander-in-Chief of Jingdong loyal volunteers, was to lead troops to relieve Qi and Huang; Zhen did not in the end go.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen, an edict ordered the Huai East and Jinghu circuits to reinforce Huai West, the Commissioner along the Yangtze to defend the river front, Feng Zhen, Acting Director of the Palace Command, to station troops at Ezhou, and Li Quan, Commander-in-Chief of the Jingdong loyal volunteers, to relieve Qi and Huang; Zhen never went.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌朔，鄂州副都統扈再興引兵攻唐州。

translations.literal: In the third month, first day bingxu, Hu Zaixing, Vice Commander-in-Chief of Ezhou, led troops to attack Tang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the first day bingxu, Hu Zaixing, Vice Commander-in-Chief of Ezhou, led troops against Tang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，金人破黃州，淮西提刑、知州事何大節棄城遁死。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the Jin took Huang Prefecture; He Dajie, Circuit Intendant of Huai West and prefect, abandoned the city and died in flight.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai, the Jin captured Huang Prefecture; He Dajie, Circuit Intendant of Huai West and prefect, abandoned the city and died while fleeing.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，長星見。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, a long-tailed star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin, a comet appeared.

sentences.zh: 李全自楚州引兵援淮西。

translations.literal: Li Quan led troops from Chuzhou to reinforce Huai West.
translations.idiomatic: Li Quan led troops from Chu Prefecture to reinforce Huai West.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，扈再興引所部趨蘄州。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Hu Zaixing led his command toward Qi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi, Hu Zaixing led his command toward Qi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲午，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu, Venus appeared in the daytime sky.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔京湖制置司趣援蘄、黃。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, an edict ordered the Jinghu Commissioner's Office to hurry reinforcements to Qi and Huang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei, an edict ordered the Jinghu Commissioner's Office to hurry reinforcements to Qi and Huang.

sentences.zh: 己亥，金人陷蘄州，知州事李誠之及其家人、官屬皆死之。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, the Jin took Qi Prefecture; Li Chengzhi, prefect, and his family and officials all died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai, the Jin captured Qi Prefecture; Prefect Li Chengzhi, his family, and his officials all died defending it.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，金人退師，扈再興邀擊，敗之於天長鎮，甲寅晦，又敗之。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the Jin withdrew; Hu Zaixing intercepted them and defeated them at Tianchang Town; on the last day jiayin, he defeated them again.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou, the Jin withdrew; Hu Zaixing ambushed them and defeated them at Tianchang Town; on the last day of the cycle, jiayin, he defeated them again.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，復置諸王宮大、小學教授。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day yimao, instructors for the great and small schools of the princely palaces were reinstated.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the day yimao, instructors for the great and small schools of the princely palaces were reinstated.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命任子簾試于御史台。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, sons of officials were ordered to undergo curtained examination at the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou, sons of officials were ordered to undergo curtained examination at the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，金人渡淮而北，李全遣兵追擊，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the Jin crossed the Huai northward; Li Quan sent troops in pursuit and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen, the Jin crossed the Huai northward; Li Quan sent troops in pursuit and routed them.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, first day jiashen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the first day jiashen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，史彌遠等上《孝宗寶訓》、《皇帝會要》。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Shi Miyuan and others presented the Precious Instructions of Emperor Xiaozong and the Imperial Compendium.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen, Shi Miyuan and others presented the Precious Instructions of Emperor Xiaozong and the Imperial Compendium.

sentences.zh: 丙申，西川地震。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, western Sichuan suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen, western Sichuan was struck by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，頒《慶元寬恤詔令》。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the Qingyuan Edict of Clemency and Relief was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi, the Qingyuan Edict of Clemency and Relief was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅朔，初置沿江制置副使司于鄂州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, first day jiayin, the office of Vice Commissioner along the River was first established at Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the first day jiayin, the office of Vice Commissioner along the Yangtze was first established at Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔以侄福州觀察使貴和爲皇子，更名竑，進封祁國公。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, an edict made the emperor's nephew Guihe, Observation Commissioner of Fuzhou, a prince; his name was changed to Hong and he was advanced to Duke of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin, an edict made the emperor's nephew Guihe, Observation Commissioner of Fuzhou, an imperial son; his name was changed to Hong and he was advanced to Duke of Qi.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以立皇子告于天地、宗廟、社稷。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the establishment of the prince was announced to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao, the establishment of the imperial son was announced to Heaven and Earth, the ancestral temple, and the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以太祖十世孫與莒補秉義郎。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Yu Ju, tenth-generation descendant of Emperor Taizu, was appointed Gentleman for Upholding Righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai, Yu Ju, tenth-generation descendant of Emperor Taizu, was appointed Gentleman for Upholding Righteousness.

sentences.zh: 丙子，減京畿囚罪一等，釋杖以下。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, sentences in the capital region were reduced one degree and prisoners below the cane punishment were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, sentences in the capital region were reduced one degree and prisoners subject to beating or lesser punishments were released.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，大風。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, great winds blew.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi, fierce winds arose.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，以趙方爲京湖制置大使，賈涉爲淮東制置使兼京東、河北路節制使。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day xinchou, Zhao Fang was made Grand Commissioner of Jing and Hu; Jia She was made Commissioner of Huai East and concurrently Controller of Jingdong and Hebei circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day xinchou, Zhao Fang was appointed Grand Commissioner of Jing and Hu; Jia She was made Commissioner of Huai East and concurrently Controller of the Jingdong and Hebei circuits.

sentences.zh: 丁未，修《光宗寶訓》。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, editing of Emperor Guangzong's Precious Instructions was undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei, work began on revising Emperor Guangzong's Precious Instructions.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，賜史彌遠家廟。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yimao, a family temple was granted to Shi Miyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day yimao, a family temple was granted to Shi Miyuan.

sentences.zh: 任希夷罷。

translations.literal: Ren Xiyi was dismissed.
