translations.idiomatic: Ren Xiyi was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以兵部尚書宣繒同知樞密院事，給事中俞應符簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Xuan Zong, Minister of War, was made Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Yu Yingfu, Supervising Censor, was made Deputy Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu, Xuan Zong, Minister of War, was appointed Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Yu Yingfu, Supervising Censor, was made Deputy Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以秉義郎與莒爲右監門衛大將軍，賜名貴誠。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Yu Ju, Gentleman for Upholding Righteousness, was made Grand General of the Right Gate Guard; he was granted the name Guicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi, Yu Ju, Gentleman for Upholding Righteousness, was made Grand General of the Right Gate Guard and granted the name Guicheng.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，追封史浩爲越王，改諡忠定，配享孝宗廟庭。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Shi Hao was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Yue, his posthumous title changed to Zhongding, and he was granted secondary sacrifice in Emperor Xiaozong's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou, Shi Hao was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Yue, given the posthumous title Zhongding, and granted secondary sacrifice in Emperor Xiaozong's temple.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以侄右監門衛大將軍貴誠爲果州團練使。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, the emperor's nephew Guicheng, Grand General of the Right Gate Guard, was made Militia Commissioner of Guozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin, the emperor's nephew Guicheng, Grand General of the Right Gate Guard, was made Militia Commissioner of Guo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，立貴誠爲沂靖惠王后。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day guiwei, Guicheng was established as heir to the Prince of Yijinghui.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day guiwei, Guicheng was established as heir to the Prince of Yijinghui.

sentences.zh: 己丑，朝獻于景靈宮。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the emperor made offerings at Jingling Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou, the emperor made offerings at Jingling Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，朝饗於太廟。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, the emperor performed court offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin, the emperor performed court offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，合祭天地於明堂，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, heaven and earth were jointly sacrificed at the Bright Hall; a general amnesty was declared.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao, heaven and earth were jointly sacrificed at the Bright Hall, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸丑，京東、河北節制司言復滄州，詔以趙澤爲河北東路鈐轄、知州事。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day guichou, the Jingdong-Hebei Control Office reported the recovery of Cangzhou; an edict appointed Zhao Ze Supervisory Controller of Hebei East Circuit and prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the day guichou, the Jingdong-Hebei Control Office reported the recovery of Cang Prefecture; an edict appointed Zhao Ze Supervisory Controller of Hebei East Circuit and prefect.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，復以齊州爲濟南府，兗州爲襲慶府。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Qi Prefecture was again made Jinan Superior Prefecture and Yan Prefecture was made Xiqing Superior Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin, Qi Prefecture was again made Jinan Superior Prefecture and Yan Prefecture was made Xiqing Superior Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，夏人復以書來四川趣會兵。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, the Western Xia again sent a letter to Sichuan urging joint mobilization.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin, the Western Xia again wrote to Sichuan urging a joint mobilization.

sentences.zh: 庚午，雷。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu, thunder sounded.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，安丙薨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jihai, An Bing died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day jihai, An Bing died.

sentences.zh: 是月，京東安撫張林叛。

translations.literal: That month, Zhang Lin, Pacification Commissioner of Jingdong, rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Zhang Lin, Pacification Commissioner of Jingdong, rebelled.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，鄭昭先罷。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day gengshen, Zheng Zhaoxian was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day gengshen, Zheng Zhaoxian was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛巳朔，以宣繒兼參知政事，俞應符兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, first day xinsi, Xuan Zong was additionally made Vice Grand Councilor and Yu Yingfu was additionally made Acting Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the first day xinsi, Xuan Zong was additionally made Vice Grand Councilor and Yu Yingfu was additionally made Acting Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以殿前司同正將華嶽等謀爲變，殺之。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Hua Yue and others, chief captains of the Palace Command, were executed for plotting rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen, Hua Yue and others, chief captains of the Palace Command, were executed for plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 是歲，浙東、江西、福建諸路旱，沔、成、階、利四州水，振之。

translations.literal: That year, the circuits of Zhedong, Jiangxi, and Fujian suffered drought; the four prefectures of Min, Cheng, Jie, and Li suffered flooding; relief was provided.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the circuits of Zhedong, Jiangxi, and Fujian suffered drought, while the four prefectures of Min, Cheng, Jie, and Li were struck by floods; relief was provided.

sentences.zh: 十五年春正月庚戌朔，御大慶殿，受恭膺天命之寶。

translations.literal: In spring of the fifteenth year, first month, first day gengxu, the emperor took the throne in the Hall of Great Celebration and received the seal Reverently Receiving the Mandate of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the fifteenth year, on the first day gengxu, the emperor took the throne in the Hall of Great Celebration and received the seal Reverently Receiving the Mandate of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，立李誠之廟於蘄州。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, a shrine to Li Chengzhi was established at Qi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou, a shrine to Li Chengzhi was established at Qi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，褒贈蘄州死事官吏，錄其子孫有差。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, officials who died in service at Qi Prefecture were posthumously honored and their descendants were enrolled with graded rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin, officials who had died in service at Qi Prefecture were posthumously honored and their descendants were enrolled with graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔撫諭山東河北軍民、將帥、官吏。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, an edict comforted and instructed soldiers and civilians, generals, and officials of Shandong and Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi, an edict was issued to reassure and instruct the soldiers, civilians, generals, and officials of Shandong and Hebei.

sentences.zh: 己未，以受寶，大赦，文武官各進秩一級，大犒諸軍。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, owing to receipt of the seal, a general amnesty was declared; civil and military officials were each advanced one rank and all armies were greatly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei, because the seal had been received, a general amnesty was proclaimed; civil and military officials were each advanced one rank and all armies were lavishly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子，罷御史台簾試任子法。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day gengzi, the Censorate's curtained examination for sons of officials was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day gengzi, the Censorate's curtained examination for sons of officials was abolished.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，詔江西提舉司振恤旱傷州縣。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day dingsi, an edict ordered the Jiangxi Intendant's Office to relieve drought-stricken prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day dingsi, an edict ordered the Jiangxi Intendant's Office to relieve drought-stricken prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬午，詔蠲蘄州今年租賦。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day renwu, an edict remitted this year's taxes and levies of Qi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the day renwu, an edict remitted this year's taxes and levies for Qi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day gengxu, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day gengxu, Venus appeared in the daytime sky.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔監司慮囚，察州縣匿囚者劾之。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, an edict ordered surveillance commissioners to review prisoners and impeach prefectures and counties that concealed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin, an edict ordered surveillance commissioners to review prisoners and impeach any prefecture or county that concealed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，進封子祁國公竑爲濟國公。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, the imperial son Hong, Duke of Qi, was advanced to Duke of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi, the imperial son Hong, Duke of Qi, was advanced to Duke of Ji.

sentences.zh: 己未，以侄果州團練使貴誠爲邵州防禦使。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, the emperor's nephew Guicheng, Militia Commissioner of Guozhou, was made Defense Commissioner of Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei, the emperor's nephew Guicheng, Militia Commissioner of Guo Prefecture, was made Defense Commissioner of Shao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，知濟南府種斌等攻張林于青州，林遁去。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Zhong Bin, Prefect of Jinan Superior Prefecture, and others attacked Zhang Lin at Qingzhou; Lin fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu, Zhong Bin, Prefect of Jinan Superior Prefecture, and others attacked Zhang Lin at Qing Prefecture; Lin fled.

sentences.zh: 己巳，修《孝宗經武要略》。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, editing of Emperor Xiaozong's Essentials of Military Governance was undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi, work began on revising Emperor Xiaozong's Essentials of Military Governance.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯，俞應符薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day xinmao, Yu Yingfu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day xinmao, Yu Yingfu died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子，詔江淮、荊襄、四川制置監司條畫營田來上。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day jiazi, an edict ordered commissioners of the Jiang-Huai, Jingxiang, and Sichuan circuits to submit plans for military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jiazi, an edict ordered commissioners of the Jiang-Huai, Jingxiang, and Sichuan circuits to submit plans for military colonies.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，命戶部詳議義役。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jimao, the Ministry of Revenue was ordered to deliberate in detail on the voluntary corvée system.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day jimao, the Ministry of Revenue was ordered to deliberate in detail on the voluntary corvée system.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔文武官毋得歸宗，著爲令。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, an edict forbade civil and military officials from returning to their clans and made this a standing regulation.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao, an edict forbade civil and military officials from returning to their clans and made this a standing regulation.

sentences.zh: 甲午，有彗星出於氐。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, a comet appeared in the constellation Di.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu, a comet appeared in the constellation Di.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，以宣繒參知政事，給事中程卓同知樞密院事，吏部尚書薛極賜出身，簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinhai, Xuan Zong was made Vice Grand Councilor; Cheng Zhuo, Supervising Censor, was made Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Xue Ji, Minister of Personnel, was granted appointment qualification and made Deputy Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day xinhai, Xuan Zong was made Vice Grand Councilor; Cheng Zhuo, Supervising Censor, was appointed Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Xue Ji, Minister of Personnel, was granted appointment qualification and made Deputy Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，雷，大雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, thunder and heavy hail.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou, thunder sounded and heavy hail fell.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，復以隨州三關隸德安府，置關使。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, the three passes of Suizhou were again placed under De'an Prefecture and pass commissioners were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi, the three passes of Suizhou were again placed under De'an Prefecture and pass commissioners were appointed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，彗星沒。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the comet disappeared.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu, the comet disappeared.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Venus was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei, Venus appeared in the daytime sky.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子，以收復京東州軍，犒賞忠義有差。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day bingzi, owing to recovery of prefectures and armies in Jingdong, loyal volunteers were rewarded in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the day bingzi, because Jingdong prefectures and armies had been recovered, the loyal volunteers were rewarded in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，赦京東、河北路。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day wuwu, Jingdong and Hebei circuits were granted amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day wuwu, Jingdong and Hebei circuits were granted amnesty.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙亥朔，發米振給臨安府貧民。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, first day yihai, rice was issued to relieve the poor of Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the first day yihai, rice was distributed to relieve the poor of Lin'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以雪寒，釋京畿及兩浙諸州杖以下囚。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, owing to snow and cold, prisoners below the cane punishment in the capital region and the prefectures of the two Zhe circuits were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, because of snow and cold, prisoners subject to beating or lesser punishments in the capital region and the prefectures of the two Zhe circuits were released.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以李全爲保寧軍節度使、右金吾衛上將軍、京東路鎮撫副使。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Li Quan was made Military Commissioner of Baoning Army, Senior General of the Right Golden Crow Guard, and Vice Pacification Commissioner of Jingdong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai, Li Quan was appointed Military Commissioner of Baoning Army, Senior General of the Right Golden Crow Guard, and Vice Pacification Commissioner of Jingdong Circuit.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月戊申，詔命官犯贓毋免約法。

translations.literal: In spring of the sixteenth year, first month, on the day wushen, an edict declared that officials guilty of corruption were not exempt from the summary law.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the sixteenth year, on the day wushen, an edict declared that officials guilty of corruption were not exempt from summary punishment.

sentences.zh: 己酉，子坻生，辛酉，命淮東制置司振給山東流民。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, the prince Di was born; on the day xinyou, the Huai East Commissioner's Office was ordered to relieve refugees from Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou, Prince Di was born; on the day xinyou, the Huai East Commissioner's Office was ordered to relieve refugees from Shandong.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子，雨土。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day wuzi, dust fell like rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day wuzi, dust rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 己丑，嗣秀王師禹薨，追封和王。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Shi Yu, heir to the Prince of Xiu, died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of He.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou, Shi Yu, heir to the Prince of Xiu, died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of He.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，子坻薨，追封邳王，諡沖美。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Prince Di died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Pi with the posthumous title Chongmei.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu, Prince Di died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Pi with the posthumous title Chongmei.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申，張林所部邢德來歸，詔進二官，復以爲京東東路副總管。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wushen, Xing De, a subordinate of Zhang Lin, came over in submission; an edict advanced him two ranks and reappointed him Vice Overall Commander of Jingdong East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day wushen, Xing De, a subordinate of Zhang Lin, came over to the Song side; an edict advanced him two ranks and reappointed him Vice Overall Commander of Jingdong East Circuit.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以道州民饑，詔發米振之。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, because the people of Daozhou were starving, an edict ordered rice issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao, because the people of Dao Prefecture were starving, an edict ordered rice distributed for relief.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲辰，詔右選試注官如左選之制。

translations.literal: In summer, fifth month, on the day jiachen, an edict ordered that examination and appointment of officials in the right selection follow the system of the left selection.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on the day jiachen, an edict ordered that examination and appointment through the right selection follow the system used for the left selection.

sentences.zh: 戊申，賜禮部進士蔣重珍以下五百四十有九人及第、出身。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, five hundred and forty-nine Jinshi graduates including Jiang Chongzhen of the Ministry of Rites were granted metropolitan degrees and appointment qualifications.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen, five hundred and forty-nine graduates of the metropolitan examination, including Jiang Chongzhen of the Ministry of Rites, were granted jinshi degrees and official appointment.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔復潭州稅酒法。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, an edict restored Tan Prefecture's taxed-wine law.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen, an edict restored Tan Prefecture's taxed-wine law.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，程卓薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day dingyou, Cheng Zhuo died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the day dingyou, Cheng Zhuo died.

sentences.zh: 秋八月辛巳，詔州縣經界毋增紹興稅額。

translations.literal: In autumn, eighth month, on the day xinsi, an edict ordered that land surveys in prefectures and counties not increase Shaoxing-era tax quotas.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on the day xinsi, an edict forbade prefectures and counties from raising tax quotas above the Shaoxing-era levels during land surveys.

sentences.zh: 癸未，申嚴舶船銅錢之禁。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, the prohibition on copper cash aboard merchant ships was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei, the prohibition on copper cash aboard merchant ships was strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, first day gengzi, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the first day gengzi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔江、淮諸司振恤被水貧民。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, an edict ordered the offices of the Jiang and Huai regions to relieve poor victims of flooding.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi, an edict ordered the offices of the Jiang and Huai regions to relieve the poor who had suffered from flooding.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，雷。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao, thunder sounded.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛亥，以太平州大水，詔振恤之。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, on the day xinhai, because Taiping Prefecture suffered great flooding, an edict ordered relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on the day xinhai, because Taiping Prefecture had suffered catastrophic flooding, an edict ordered relief.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳，命淮東、西總領及沿江被水州募江西、湖南民入米補官。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day xinsi, the overall directors of Huai East and West and flood-stricken prefectures along the river were ordered to recruit people of Jiangxi and Hunan to offer grain in exchange for official appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day xinsi, the overall directors of Huai East and West and flood-stricken prefectures along the Yangtze were ordered to recruit people from Jiangxi and Hunan to offer grain in exchange for official rank.

sentences.zh: 癸未，嗣濮王不淩薨。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Bu Ling, heir to the Prince of Pu, died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei, Bu Ling, heir to the Prince of Pu, died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，雷。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen, thunder sounded.

sentences.zh: 十七年春正月戊戌朔，詔補先聖裔孔元用爲通直郎，錄程頤後。

translations.literal: In spring of the seventeenth year, first month, first day wuxu, an edict appointed Kong Yuanyong, descendant of the Sage, as Gentleman for Direct Remonstrance and enrolled descendants of Cheng Yi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the seventeenth year, on the first day wuxu, an edict appointed Kong Yuanyong, a descendant of Confucius, as Gentleman for Direct Remonstrance and enrolled descendants of Cheng Yi.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命淮東西、湖北路轉運司提督營屯田。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, the transport offices of Huai East and West and Hubei circuits were ordered to supervise military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai, the transport offices of Huai East and West and Hubei circuits were ordered to supervise military colonies.

sentences.zh: 二月癸巳，蠲台州逋賦十萬餘緡。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day guisi, more than one hundred thousand strings of arrears in Taizhou were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the day guisi, more than one hundred thousand strings of tax arrears in Tai Prefecture were remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲午，命臨安府振糶貧民。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Lin'an Prefecture was ordered to sell grain at relief prices to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu, Lin'an Prefecture was ordered to sell grain at relief prices to the poor.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑，雪。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day guichou, snow.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day guichou, it snowed.

sentences.zh: 是月，金人迫西和州，尋引兵還。

translations.literal: That month, Jin forces pressed Xihe Prefecture, then soon withdrew their troops.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jin forces pressed Xihe Prefecture, then soon withdrew.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛卯，詔廬州振糶饑民。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day xinmao, an edict ordered Luzhou to sell grain at relief prices to famine victims.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the day xinmao, an edict ordered Lu Prefecture to sell grain at relief prices to famine victims.

sentences.zh: 乙未，賜李全、彭義斌錢三十萬緡爲犒賞戰士費。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Li Quan and Peng Yibin were granted three hundred thousand strings of cash as funds to reward their soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei, Li Quan and Peng Yibin were granted three hundred thousand strings of cash to reward their troops.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，詔核實兩淮、京湖、四川、江上諸軍之數。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day wuxu, an edict ordered verification of troop numbers in the two Huai circuits, Jinghu, Sichuan, and armies along the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day wuxu, an edict ordered a verification of troop numbers in the two Huai circuits, Jinghu, Sichuan, and the armies along the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯朔，太白經天，晝見。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, first day dingmao, Venus crossed the heavens and was visible in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the first day dingmao, Venus traversed the sky and appeared in the daytime.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，知西和州尚震午坐金兵至謀遁，奪三官、岳州居住。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Shang Zhenwu, prefect of Xihe Prefecture, was punished for plotting flight when Jin troops arrived; he was stripped of three ranks and ordered to reside at Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou, Shang Zhenwu, prefect of Xihe Prefecture, was punished for plotting to flee when Jin troops arrived; he was stripped of three ranks and ordered to reside at Yue Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，大名府蘇椿等舉城來歸，詔悉補官，即以其州授之。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Su Chun and others of Daming Superior Prefecture surrendered the city in submission; an edict appointed them all to office and immediately granted them the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen, Su Chun and others of Daming Superior Prefecture surrendered the city to the Song; an edict appointed them all to office and immediately granted them the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉朔，命福建路監司振恤被水貧民。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, first day dingyou, surveillance commissioners of Fujian Circuit were ordered to relieve poor flood victims.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the first day dingyou, surveillance commissioners of Fujian Circuit were ordered to relieve the poor who had suffered from flooding.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，命師嵓嗣秀王。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Shi Yan was appointed heir to the Prince of Xiu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai, Shi Yan was appointed heir to the Prince of Xiu.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥，罷通州天賜鹽場。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yihai, the Tiansi salt works of Tong Prefecture were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day yihai, the Tiansi salt works of Tong Prefecture were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，帝不豫。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the emperor fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu, the emperor fell gravely ill.

sentences.zh: 閏八月乙未朔，申嚴兩浙諸州輸苗過取之禁。

translations.literal: In the intercalary eighth month, first day yiwei, the prohibition on excessive collection of grain tax in the prefectures of the two Zhe circuits was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eighth month, on the first day yiwei, the prohibition on excessive collection of grain tax in the prefectures of the two Zhe circuits was strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，皇帝崩于福寧殿，年五十七。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the emperor died in Funing Hall at the age of fifty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou, the emperor died in Funing Hall at the age of fifty-seven.

sentences.zh: 史彌遠傳遺詔，立侄貴誠爲皇子，更名昀，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: Shi Miyuan transmitted the deathbed edict, establishing the emperor's nephew Guicheng as prince, changing his name to Yun, who immediately took the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Miyuan transmitted the deathbed edict establishing the emperor's nephew Guicheng as imperial son, changing his name to Yun, who immediately ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 尊皇后爲皇太后，垂簾聽政。

translations.literal: The empress was honored as empress dowager and ruled from behind the curtain.
translations.idiomatic: The empress was honored as empress dowager and assumed regency from behind the curtain.

sentences.zh: 進封皇子竑爲濟陽郡王，出居湖州。

translations.literal: The imperial son Hong was advanced to Prince of Jiyang and sent to reside at Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial son Hong was advanced to Prince of Jiyang and sent to reside at Hu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 寶慶元年正月己丑，諡曰仁文哲武恭孝皇帝，廟號寧宗。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Baoqing, on the day jichou, the posthumous title was Renwen Zhewu Gongxiao Emperor and the temple name Ningzong.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Baoqing, on the day jichou, he was given the posthumous title Emperor Renwen Zhewu Gongxiao and the temple name Ningzong.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，葬於會稽之永茂陵。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day guiyou, he was buried at Yongmao Mausoleum in Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the day guiyou, he was buried at Yongmao Mausoleum in Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 三年九月，加諡法天備道純德茂功仁文哲武聖睿恭孝皇帝。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the third year, the posthumous title was augmented to Emperor Fatian Beidao Chunde Maogong Renwen Zhewu Shengrui Gongxiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the third year, his posthumous title was augmented to Emperor Fatian Beidao Chunde Maogong Renwen Zhewu Shengrui Gongxiao.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：宋世內禪者四，寧宗之禪，獨當事勢之難，能不失禮節焉，斯可謂善處矣。

translations.literal: The encomium says: In the Song there were four abdications in favor of successors; Ningzong's abdication alone faced the hardest circumstances of the times, yet he did not depart from ritual propriety — this may be called handling the matter well.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium says: The Song saw four abdications in favor of a successor, but Ningzong's alone came at the hardest moment in affairs; that he did not depart from ritual propriety may truly be called handling the matter well.

sentences.zh: 初年以舊學輔導之功，召用宿儒，引拔善類，一時守文繼體之政，燁然可觀。

translations.literal: In his early years, owing to the merit of his former studies and guidance, he summoned established scholars and promoted worthy men; for a time the policy of preserving the cultural inheritance and continuing the institutional order was brilliantly visible.
translations.idiomatic: In his early years, drawing on the merit of his former studies and tutelage, he summoned established scholars and promoted worthy men; for a time the policy of preserving the cultural inheritance and sustaining the institutional order shone brightly.

sentences.zh: 中更侂胄用事，內蓄群奸，至指正人爲邪，正學爲偽，外挑強鄰，流毒淮甸。

translations.literal: Midway Han Tuozhou came to power, harboring a host of villains within, going so far as to call upright men wicked and orthodox learning false, and provoking powerful neighbors abroad, spreading calamity through the Huai region.
translations.idiomatic: Midway through his reign Han Tuozhou came to power, harboring a host of villains within, going so far as to brand upright men as wicked and orthodox learning as false, while abroad he provoked powerful neighbors and spread calamity across the Huai region.

sentences.zh: 頻歲兵敗，乃函侂胄之首，行成于金，國體虧矣。

translations.literal: After years of repeated military defeat, Tuozhou's head was sent in a box and peace was made with the Jin — the dignity of the state was thereby diminished.
translations.idiomatic: After years of repeated defeat in war, Tuozhou's head was sent in a box and peace was made with the Jin; the dignity of the state was thereby diminished.

sentences.zh: 既而彌遠擅權，幸帝耄荒，竊弄威福。

translations.literal: Thereafter Miyuan monopolized power, taking advantage of the emperor's senility and confusion to usurp authority and bestow favor at will.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Miyuan monopolized power, taking advantage of the emperor's senility and confusion to wield authority and bestow favor as he pleased.

sentences.zh: 至於皇儲國統，乘機伺間，亦得遂其廢立之私，他可知也。

translations.literal: As for the heir apparent and the succession to the throne, seizing opportunities and watching for openings, he likewise achieved his private aims of deposing and establishing rulers — the rest may be inferred.
translations.idiomatic: When it came to the heir apparent and the succession to the throne, seizing opportunities as they arose, he likewise achieved his private aims of deposing and establishing rulers; the rest may be inferred.

sentences.zh: 雖然，宋東都至於仁宗，四傳而享國百年，邵雍稱爲前代所無，南渡至寧宗，亦四傳而享國九十有八年，是亦豈偶然哉。

translations.literal: Even so, from the Eastern Capital of the Song down to Renzong, four successions enjoyed a century of rule; Shao Yong called this unmatched in former ages; from the southward crossing down to Ningzong, there were likewise four successions enjoying ninety-eight years of rule. Could this be mere chance?
translations.idiomatic: Even so, from the Song Eastern Capital down to Renzong, four successions enjoyed a century of rule, which Shao Yong called unmatched in former ages; from the southward crossing down to Ningzong, there were likewise four successions and ninety-eight years of rule. Could this be mere chance?

sentences.zh: 惜乎神器授受之際，寧、理之視仁、英，其跡雖同，其情相去遠矣。

translations.literal: It is a pity that at the moment of receiving and transmitting the sacred vessel, Ningzong and Lizong compared with Renzong and Yingzong: though their outward traces were the same, the realities behind them were far apart.
translations.idiomatic: It is a pity that at the moment of receiving and transmitting the throne, Ningzong and Lizong compared with Renzong and Yingzong: though the outward form was the same, the realities behind them were worlds apart.
